collections.label: Monthly return candidates
notes: All null and quality-filtered observations retained. Symbols have candidate status; do not silently join historical issuers by current ticker.

collections.label: Monthly returns valid candidates
notes: Non-null quality-filtered return histories only; issuer/security identity remains provisional. All exclusions retained in companion records.

collections.label: Historical return link coverage
notes: Diagnostic only: snapshot publication dates often follow return month; this is not an investable point-in-time backtest.

collections.label: Holding price links
notes: Existing reviewed candidate links preserved verbatim; price agreement does not establish a permanent security ID.

collections.label: Spy historical holdings
notes: Every canonical SPY holding retained; missing reported ticker remains null. Includes the row omitted by composite proxy selection.

collections.label: Historical proxy holdings
notes: Composite selects SPY where complete, IVV for gaps. Original fund identity, source evidence, and null publication dates preserved. ETF holdings are not official index membership.

collections.label: Ivv bootstrap 2014q4
notes: Unknown original historical release date retained as null; retrospective 2015Q1 name/ticker matches are candidates.

collections.label: Holdings dated supported symbols
notes: Companion records preserve all excluded memberships. same-quarter cross-fund evidence and retrospective primary evidence remain explicit in companion. Historical knowledge of identity is not independently guaranteed.

collections.label: Sec filing index
notes: Metadata index of full corpus. Original local text/raw files stay in source repository; availability status is not a guarantee every filing contains sustainability measurements.

collections.label: Sec latest company documents
notes: Latest retrieved report per CIK and base form for immediate app browsing; full historical index is a companion dataset.

collections.label: Sec text exhibits
notes: Only four separately normalized exhibit records. Not a complete exhibits or subsidiary network dataset.

collections.label: Financial latest concepts
notes: Latest period then latest filing per CIK/metric/taxonomy/tag/unit. This is a current concept view, not a historical as-of panel. Competing tags and cumulative YTD versus quarter flows are not merged. Full 1,786,135-row source retained by path/hash.

collections.label: Financial latest observations
notes: Available date is filed date plus one calendar day from original normalization. Do not treat current latest view as known in earlier backtest months.

collections.label: Gleif issuer records
notes: Current LEI metadata; this file contains no direct/ultimate-parent edges.

collections.label: Primary security identity evidence
notes: Review dates and evidence filing dates retained. Retrospective issuer evidence is not information availability on the historical holding date.

collections.label: Momentum monthly full
notes: Full Momentum-only history from 1927-01; FF5 starts 1963-07. Source percentage converted once to decimals.

collections.label: Latest universe snapshot
notes: Original latest proxy snapshot. Null scores mean no scored company claim. Does not meet companySchema and must not be silently coerced.

collections.label: Financial facts all vintages
notes: All original normalized as-filed records preserved, including amendment vintages, competing concepts, null values, and flagged date anomalies. Values are reported accounting units, not scores. Each gzip partition decompresses to at most 1.9 MB. Original source row number is one-based and locates the exact source fact. Publication/available dates retain original filed date plus one calendar day policy.

collections.label: Spy all source observations
notes: All original source observations, not deduplicated canonical memberships. Preserve is_canonical_snapshot and source_kind to avoid double-counting overlapping sources.

collections.label: Ivv full ordinary equity history
notes: All IVV ordinary-equity observations retained independently of composite proxy selection. Original weights, rounding and unknown source_publication_date retained.

collections.label: Sec document archive index
notes: Exact local archive-relative paths, hashes, accession and source URLs for every retained document. Text and original document bytes are archive-only and are not hosted by this normalized stage; do not claim full-text search of hosted contents. CIK null/cofiler arrays are preserved without guessing.

collections.label: Sec filing date conflicts
notes: Original acceptance-time conflicts retained with exact observation evidence; resolve before intraday availability calculations.

collections.label: Fdic bank report index
notes: All 421 bank report metadata records, preserved FDIC IDs and source URLs. Original attachments/text remain in source archive.

collections.label: Companies
notes: All 743 historical issuer records, including unmatched companies. Ticker hints and contemporary LEI/name matches are not proof of historical identity.

collections.label: Climate trace ownership
notes: USA ownership source rows, with exact native IDs and chains. No effective dates supplied. Unknown shares remain null.

collections.label: Climate trace owner entities
notes: Owner entities in retained ownership files. These are not necessarily listed operating companies.

collections.label: Climate trace company entity links
notes: All 300 supplied entity links, including 15 missing native entity IDs. Attribution factors with unknown edges are assumptions, not verified shares.

collections.label: Climate trace company asset links
notes: All source company/asset matches; a matched chain node is not necessarily the operator or a currently controlled subsidiary.

collections.label: Climate trace entity emissions
notes: All cached native owner/year values. Retained independently of company matching; unlinked owners remain available.

collections.label: Climate trace linked owner entities
notes: Additional native immediate owners and cached owner IDs absent from the parent-owner table. Names remain null if no source name is available.

collections.label: Climate trace company emissions
notes: 460 derived company/year rows. Values retain upstream assumptions and must not be called corporate footprints.

collections.label: Climate trace reconciliation issues
notes: Differences from recomputing rounded exported factors and missing cache evidence.

collections.label: Climate trace assets
notes: Unique assets in all retained USA ownership files plus the retained Exxon global API sample. Coordinates remain null where unavailable.

collections.label: Climate trace facility emissions
notes: Retained global Exxon-filter sample of 52 asset/year estimates. No inferred coordinates or ownership weighting.

collections.label: Climate trace reduction strategies
notes: All strategy rows matched to retained ownership/API asset IDs, selected by exact native asset ID. Other global rows counted but not duplicated.

collections.label: Climate trace inventory context
notes: Country and global sector/subsector context, preserving month, Jan–June YTD and full-year boundaries. City tables inventoried only.

collections.label: Ca100 source documents

collections.label: Ca100 company rounds

collections.label: Ca100 assessment definitions
notes: Round-specific metric labels and original header comments. Methodology and target windows vary; do not pool codes without definitions.

collections.label: Ca100 assessment rows
notes: Every selected current-round assessment cell, preserving categories, missing values and exact workbook locators.

collections.label: Ca100 indicator observations
notes: Overall indicator assessments in long form. valueText is categorical; numeric value is null by design. Targets are not outcomes.

collections.label: Ca100 source notes
notes: Workbook header/footer evidence including data cutoffs, scoring rules and corporate identity changes.

collections.label: Ca100 sheet inventory
notes: Actual sheet dimensions/states, identifying the current disclosure sheet and preventing legacy-sheet relabeling.

collections.label: Ca100 supplement tables
notes: Supplementary accounting, alignment, sector and policy assessment table definitions with original date/unit headers.

collections.label: Ca100 supplement rows
notes: Supplementary company records retain original column keys, categorical/numeric text, dates and comments. Units and periods are column-specific.

collections.label: Ca100 rounds
notes: Verified current disclosure-table counts and cutoff dates for six assessment rounds.

collections.label: Source files
notes: Input file fingerprints and retained provenance. Upstream URL/retrieval metadata are copied from captured manifests; this preparation performs no network refresh.

Publisher data contain genuine reported zero USD cells and rounding/restatement differences. Null is reserved for missing cells and is not changed into zero.

Annual, total, client, parent, alternate-edition and superseded tables overlap. They must not be summed together. Expansion submetrics can overlap too.
Current roster contains 65 banks, while 70 banks appear across supplied editions. Roster-specific totals require the explicit bank_in_2026_roster field.

CIK associations in the supplied delivery are name-based candidates only. Exact names do not establish issuer identity or historic ownership. Eight substring/fuzzy links need particular review, including former-name and subsidiary-name cases. No match was promoted to a verified identifier.
121 of 743 target companies are name-matched by the source; 622 are not found. Absence is not zero emissions or proof of no fossil exposure. Source target universe is preserved.
Bank-client-parent labels are publisher aggregation categories and differ across edition/files for some groups. They are not a complete dated ownership or supplier network.
Publisher data contain genuine reported zero USD cells and rounding/restatement differences. Null is reserved for missing cells and is not changed into zero.

No affirmative formal reuse or redistribution license was verified for the aggregate CSVs. Methodology copyright and all-rights-reserved text are present; underlying transaction-level records are explicitly restricted and not included.
Local saved methodology HTML is not the methodology PDF. Methodology and 2026 release date were checked at the primary URLs online during this integration.
Profiles contain qualitative text and URLs, not independently verified policy scores. Existing source match_score is string-matching confidence and is never a sustainability score.
